videos.title: Terence Tao – How the world’s top mathematician uses AI
videos.description: We begin the episode with the absolutely ingenious and surprising way in which Kepler discovered the laws of planetary motion.  People sometimes say that AI will make especially fast progress at scientific discovery because of tight verification loops. But the story of how we discovered the shape of our solar system shows how the verification loop for correct ideas can be decades (or even millennia) long.  During this time, what we know today as the better theory can often actually make worse predictions (Copernicus's model of circular orbits around the sun was actually less accurate than Ptolemy's geocentric model). And the reasons it survives this epistemic hell is some mixture of judgment and heuristics that we don’t even understand well enough to actually articulate, much less codify into an RL loop.  Hope you enjoy! videos.title: I Run 20 OpenClaw Agents 24/7! Here's How to Set up Agent Teams
videos.description: Here is how to run OpenClaw agents on a VPS for $7/month. Set it up on Hostinger, 10% off with code MOE-LUEKER: https://www.hostinger.com/moe-lueker  I'm running 20 OpenClaw agents around the clock and they're doing actual useful work — building apps overnight, drafting scripts, scanning for trends, and coordinating with my team. Most tutorials show you how to summarize the news. That's not useful. In this video I walk through my complete agent setup from scratch: how to configure each agent with its own identity using soul.md and agents.md, how to wire them together with an orchestrator, and how to build a command center dashboard to manage your entire fleet from one screen.  RESOURCES: • Set up OpenClaw on Hostinger (10% off with code MOE-LUEKER): https://www.hostinger.com/moe-lueker • FREE OpenClaw Agent Setup Guide: https://moelueker.gumroad.com/l/agent-setup-guide • Custom Agent Dashboard Prompt + Instructions: https://moelueker.gumroad.com/l/agent-command-center  Other Resources: • FREE OpenClaw Cost Optimization Guide: https://moelueker.gumroad.com/l/Clawdbot-Cost-Saver • OpenClaw Playbook (setup + 15 first prompts + agent training): https://moelueker.gumroad.com/l/clawdbot-playbook • Sign up for OpenRouter: https://openrouter.ai/ • Get your OpenAI API Key: https://platform.openai.com/api-keys • Part 1 — Clawdbot Setup for Beginners: https://youtu.be/pSvsLwGMy4A • Part 2 — 15 First Prompts for OpenClaw: https://youtu.be/5Xo_ni5VT-Y • Part 3 — How to Cut OpenClaw API Costs by 97%: https://youtu.be/-MtzLiQ9w1c • Support the channel: https://moelueker.com/support/  🔍 KEY TAKEAWAYS: • An OpenClaw agent is not a chatbot. A chatbot answers your question. An agent has a goal, tools to accomplish it, and a schedule — it runs without you. • Every agent needs two config files. soul.md defines its identity, personality, and behavioral rules. agents.md sets its startup instructions, tools, cron schedule, and output location. These two files determine 80% of how useful your agent becomes. • The orchestrator pattern is what makes a multi-agent fleet actually coordinate. One orchestrator routes tasks to specialist agents — content, research, dev, sales — and each agent writes outputs to a shared workspace. • Keep soul.md under 500 words. Agents read it on every single prompt — the longer it is, the more tokens it burns and the more diluted your rules become. • Agents improve over time when you train them. Rate their outputs, give feedback, and they adjust. Most people skip this step entirely.  📈 TIPS FOR OPENCLAW AGENT SETUP: • Build the orchestrator before adding more than three agents. Without coordination, agents overlap on tasks and burn through API credits fast. • Start with three agents: orchestrator, content agent, research agent. Get those working reliably before expanding. Three agents with tight configuration outperform twenty with loose setup. • Give each agent a specific output folder in a shared workspace. Agents writing to the same location without structure create conflicts. • When agents hit errors, copy the logs and paste them directly into ChatGPT or Gemini with a note saying "fix these." You don't need to understand the logs — just let another model read them. • Use the auto-generate prompt in the free guide to build your dashboard. It asks you nine questions and writes the full build prompt based on your answers. • Use OpenRouter instead of direct API keys from day one. One key, access to every major model, and you can assign a different model to each agent without changing config files. • The dev agent is the one to set up first if you're a content creator. Give it your niche and let it build tools for you. Check back in two days.  If your OpenClaw agents feel dumb or repetitive, the issue is almost always missing soul.md configuration and no coordination layer between agents. The setup in this video covers both. Once those are working, scaling to 20 agents is straightforward.  🎥 SUBSCRIBE, LIKE & COMMENT: Building your own OpenClaw agent setup? Comment below — what kind of agent would you build first?  ❤️ LOVED THIS VIDEO?: You'd make my day if you support this type of content by buying me a coffee 🤩 https://moelueker.com/support/  ⏱️ CHAPTERS: 00:00 Intro — 20 OpenClaw Agents Running for $7/Month 01:00 What My Agents Actually Built (Real Outputs) 02:20 My Full Agent Fleet Breakdown 03:42 Setting Up OpenClaw on Hostinger (Step by Step) 05:50 Agent vs Chatbot — The Key Difference 06:36 Seeing Your Full OpenClaw Agent Setup 07:29 Creating Your First Agent (soul.md and agents.md) 09:05 Tools, Skills, and Cron Jobs Walkthrough 11:09 Agent Personality Tips and soul.md Deep Dive 11:35 Building a Multi-Agent Team 12:16 Connecting Agents with an Orchestrator 12:54 Building the Agent Dashboard (Command Center) 15:31 Auto-Generate Your Dashboard with One Prompt 16:01 Troubleshooting with Logs 17:00 Recap and What to Do Next  #OpenClaw #AIAgents #Clawdbot
